proofSummary.repositoryMutationAudit: PASS — one legitimate existing-file mutation plus five expected new files

keyConclusions: Run occurrence identity must be independent from semantic ActionIdentity so repeated Standard Actions remain distinct.
Existing OwnerAuthorityFact should be persisted exactly when actually supplied; persistence must not infer or upgrade authority.
Result persistence can validate exact Run/Action linkage while keeping action-specific payload semantics opaque until Result admission.
Malformed, extra-field, identity-mismatched, non-JSON or corrupt durable records must fail closed without normalization or repair.
Repository persistence should align with stable-transfer v4 dated physical Run topology and avoid a second .flowkit storage tree.
Complex crash recovery, worker takeover and multi-Agent orchestration are outside this Change.
limitations: Explore proof is bounded to the supplied Linux detached checkpoint and exact tool/runtime bundles.
The temp+rename experiment does not claim whole-platform power-loss atomicity; Windows acceptance remains later Delivery work.
This Change does not define Result admission, Policy legality, automatic resume execution, Run allocation scheduling or Delivery Full Test verification.
The Run remains an external-orchestrator stable-transfer bridge record and is not claimed to have been emitted by candidate Flowkit runtime.

OpenSpec validate --all --strict reports the active pre-Proposal change as invalid because no delta specs exist yet; canonical specs themselves validate 2/2 PASS and status remains the intended 0/4 Explore boundary.
